notes.title: 11/1 bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where stuff roll speedup did not work with pad input.

notes.title: 10/31 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Updated today.

-Change the default key assignment on the keypad to Button2.
-The operation keys in the options are fixed independently of the assignment.
-Disable keypad cross key assignment.
-Disable Quit button assignment.

-Added a specification to stop processing when the game window is not active.
-Even if the top key is inserted in the air, it will not enter the door until the top key is reinserted after landing.

-Partially revised the option names on the title screen.
-Fixed fatal garbled characters when selecting English.

-The specification that the strange chest can increase the strange chest is invalidated.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Postscript:
The staff roll at the ending accelerates while pressing the enter button.
This is an operation that is not described anywhere, so I will introduce it here.

727 Not Hound

notes.title: Supplement about Controller Settings
notes.content:
When using a regular PC gamepad or Xbox gamepad,

Launch Steam Client

1.Select "Steam"
2.Select "Settings"
3.Select "Controller"
4.Select "GENERAL CONTROLLER SETTINGS"

Can be enabled by turning off all support settings.

727 Not Hound
